concerns.text: FR-005 requires a False Discovery Rate correction on the p‑values of the 30 feature coefficients. No task in tasks.md explicitly performs an FDR correction on coefficient p‑values; T016 applies FDR to permutation‑importance scores, which does not satisfy the specification.

SC-002 expects the FDR‑adjusted p‑value for the top predictive feature (derived from coefficient p‑values) to be reported. The current tasks (T016) adjust p‑values from permutation importance, not from model coefficients, leaving this success criterion uncovered.
